name: Dimitrios Papakonstantinou
bio:
Dimitrios's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for rally racing in the mountains of Greece. He pursued a degree in mechanical engineering, focusing on vehicle dynamics and control. After graduating, he spent several years as a data analyst for a small touring car team, quickly proving his aptitude for identifying performance bottlenecks and optimizing vehicle setups. He transitioned into test driving roles, where his keen eye for detail and ability to communicate technical feedback made him invaluable.

Dimitrios's approach to test driver coordination is meticulous and demanding. He believes in rigorous testing protocols and expects drivers to provide comprehensive and accurate feedback. He excels at interpreting driver input and translating it into actionable improvements for the engineering team. His experience with various racing formats has provided him with a broad understanding of vehicle behavior across diverse conditions.

What sets Dimitrios apart is his unwavering commitment to performance and his ability to foster a culture of continuous improvement. He's known for his direct communication style and isn't afraid to challenge conventional wisdom, making him a respected, if sometimes challenging, figure in the paddock.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight receding hairline.
physical.description: Dimitrios has a sturdy build and a focused intensity in his dark eyes.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen, even during casual conversations.
Insists on using metric units exclusively, even when working with international teams.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
